The live, online Language Access 101 training for behavioral health providers includes a comprehensive overview of the multi-faceted concept known as Language Access. The training will review essential components of Language Access such as basic definitions and key terms, as well more dynamic ideas such as Language Access as a human right and the intersection of language and disability justice. Trainers will review practical Language Access information such as how to work with an interpreter, how to fund Language Access services and what tangible Language Access resources are available. Language Access requirements and laws, as well as behavioral health professional standards and ethical obligations regarding Language Access will also be covered.
